text:
Clara: quick follow-up from the retry/resume sync. i want a small proposal that keeps the SDK surfaces consistent across py/ts/go without exposing token internals.
Jon: yes please. main constraints: ergonomic defaults, safe auto-resume only for idempotent ops, and graceful fallback when token version unknown.
Priya: proposal: transport advertises a concise capability header `X-Resume-Caps` with: v, caps, resume_mode, expires_ms. SDK parses header but treats token as opaque.
Eli: agree. for resume semantics: auto-resume allowed only when: (1) op is idempotent, (2) token_version <= sdk_known, and (3) resume_mode != "explicit". otherwise SDK surfaces `ResumeNotAllowed`.
Clara: small state machine: IN_FLIGHT -> RETRY -> RESUME -> SUCCESS/FAIL. persist minimal state: last_ack_index + token.
Jon: tests: add cross-lang contract tests for unknown-version, clock-skew, and resume-negative (server rejects resumed request). make a tiny fake transport for CI.
Priya: SDK surface mapping: py: `client.list(..., auto_resume=True)` default True; ts: options object; go: functional opts. expose `allow_experimental_resume` flag.
Eli: telemetry hooks: emit resume_attempt/resume_success/resume_failure/token_expired events. redact token in logs, only emit a digest.
Clara: notes for RFC: header examples, state machine diagram, minimal pseudocode for retry+resume loop, and migration note for customers.
Bot: created ticket INFENG-9991: "resume-cap-header + cross-sdk contract tests" and linked this thread.
Clara: thanks team — i'll draft the RFC update and label owners.
